title: High-Protein Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
description: Tender chicken breast and crisp broccoli tossed in a savory ginger-garlic sauce, served over wholesome brown rice. This easy skillet dinner packs 35 grams of protein per serving and comes together quickly.
steps: Cook the brown rice in a medium saucepan according to package instructions until tender and fluffy; set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the low-sodium soy sauce, honey, minced ginger, minced garlic, cornstarch, and cold water until smooth.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat for 2 minutes until shimmering.

Add the diced chicken breast to the skillet and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center registers 165°F (74°C); transfer the chicken to a clean plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet over medium-high heat, add the broccoli florets, and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender and bright green.

Return the cooked chicken to the skillet with the broccoli, pour the soy sauce mixture over top, and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce bubbles and thickens into a glossy glaze coating the chicken and vegetables.
tips: Make sure your chicken pieces are cut to a uniform size so they cook evenly.
For faster weeknight prep, cook the brown rice ahead of time or use frozen microwaveable brown rice pouches.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in a skillet or microwave until steaming hot.

video_script.hook: Make this 35-gram protein chicken and broccoli stir-fry in just 35 minutes.
steps_short: Cook the brown rice until fluffy and tender.
Whisk together the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, and cornstarch.
Cook the diced chicken breast in olive oil until it reaches 165 degrees.
Stir-fry the fresh broccoli florets until crisp-tender.
Toss the chicken and broccoli with the sauce until glossy.
